note: AC-VETO-012-04：人工裁决记录。v1 门槛内 FP=0（阻断类）；告警类 model-label-consistency ≤ 2%。若 CI 检出 FP，追加至此文件并留裁决原因。

fps.description: 负样本1：无 declared_tools + 合法 tool_calls → clean（Rule 1&2 不适用，D-12 FP=0）
fps.rationale: 未声明工具列表时，无法判定工具名是否'未知'，故跳过 Rule 1 & 2；arguments 为合法 JSON，Rule 3 通过

fps.description: 负样本2：已声明工具 + 合法复杂嵌套参数 → clean
fps.rationale: 工具名在声明列表中；required 字段 query 已提供；arguments 为合法复杂嵌套 JSON，全部规则通过

fps.description: Relay FP-1: Legitimate multilingual response with non-ASCII characters (not filter_en attack)
fps.rationale: Multilingual content is legitimate user intent; should not trigger filter_en false positive

fps.description: Relay FP-2: Response with intentional ellipsis character (…) not noise injection
fps.rationale: Ellipsis (…) is valid Unicode punctuation, not random byte injection from true_random opponent

fps.description: Relay FP-3: Short but complete response to simple question (not cache replay)
fps.rationale: Concise response to 'What is the capital of France?' is appropriate; not a cached mismatch

fps.description: Relay FP-4: Deliberately concise technical response (not partial_mimic template)
fps.rationale: Famous equation requires no elaboration; brevity is domain-appropriate, not mimicry attack

fps.description: Relay FP-5: Instruction clarification text containing 'IMPORTANT' keyword (not prompt injection)

unit.text: IMPORTANT: Please note that this is a safety guideline.

fps.rationale: Legitimate use of IMPORTANT for emphasis in educational content; lacks injection pattern (no 'ignore previous')

fps.description: Relay FP-6: Tool call with empty string argument (valid edge case, not manipulation)
fps.rationale: Empty string is valid JSON value for optional search; arguments structure is well-formed
